;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**More than 100 [[Afghan National Army|Afghan soldiers]] and police, 13 civilians and hundreds of [[Taliban]] are killed during the [[Ghazni offensive|ongoing offensive in Ghazni]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45168890 (BBC)]
**The [[Taliban]] captures Camp Chenaya, an [[Afghan Army]] base in [[Ghormach District]], [[Faryab Province]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/taliban-capture-afghan-army-base-after-intense-fighting/4527662.html (Voice of America)]
*At least 40 people are killed by paramilitary forces in eastern [[Ethiopia]], in the latest spate of violence driven by ethnic divisions. [https://www.voanews.com/a/at-least-40-killed-by-paramilitaries-in-eastern-ethiopia/4526733.html (Voice of America)]
;Business and economy
*[[2018–2021 Turkish currency and debt crisis|Turkish currency and debt crisis]]
**Asian stock prices sink as [[Turkey]]’s financial turmoil fuels fears [[Financial contagion|contagion]] might spread to other emerging markets. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/turkish-currency-crisis-drags-down-asian-stock-markets-2018-08-12 (Market Watch)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Laos dam collapse]]
**The death toll from a dam collapse in [[Laos]] on 23 July rises to 36, while 98 people are still missing. [https://wap.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/death-toll-reaches-36-in-laos-dam-collapse-98-missing-118081300164_1.html (''Business Standard'')]
*Authorities in [[India]] confirm that 774 people have been killed so far during [[monsoon]] rains. [https://www.financialexpress.com/india-news/monsoon-in-india-staggering-774-people-died-due-to-heavy-rains-floods-in-these-states/1278828/ (''Financial Express'')]
*Nine people are killed and 16 others injured after a fire breaks out in a ward on the seventh floor of a hospital in [[New Taipei City]], [[Taiwan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45166240 (BBC)]
*More than 300 people are injured, five seriously, after a section of wooden jetty collapsed at an urban sports and music festival in [[Vigo]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45165660 (BBC)]
*Twelve fans of Ecuadorian football team [[Barcelona S.C.]] are killed and 30 others are injured after the bus they were traveling on overturns in [[Azuay]], [[Ecuador]]. [http://spanish.xinhuanet.com/2018-08/13/c_137386716.htm (Xinhua)]
*Three Russian climbers and two Tajik pilots die while 12 other people are injured in a helicopter crash in [[Tajikistan]]. [https://www.tampabay.com/-die-in-helicopter-crash-in-tajikistans-pamir-mountains-ap_worldeb7d9400a9c843faab98c3e09995a939 (''Tampa Bay Times'')]
*41 people are injured when a coach overturns in [[Kent]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.kentlive.news/news/kent-news/live-m25-traffic-updates-crash-1892999 (''Kent Live'')]
;International relations 
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]] and [[South Korea]] officials begin high-level negotiations, with reports suggesting that [[Kim Jong-un]] and [[Moon Jae-in]] could be planning for a [[Inter-Korean summits|summit]] in [[Pyongyang]] later this month. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southkorea-talks/north-south-korea-begin-talks-before-possible-pyongyang-summit-idUSKBN1KY00U (Reuters)]
;Politics and elections

**The lawyer of [[Peter Strzok]], a former agent of the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] (FBI) who was removed from [[Robert Mueller]]'s [[Mueller special counsel investigation|Special Counsel investigation]], announces that his client has been fired by the FBI. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/fbi-agent-peter-strzok-fired-over-anti-trump-texts/ar-BBLSuUI (''The Washington Post'' via MSN)]
